digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and timezone validation
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ lint rule families must be enabled in pyproject.toml after all violations are remediated.
Timestamp validation in validate_checks.py must explicitly use UTC timezone for both epoch-seconds conversion and timezone-less persisted strings.
Security pin cadence decisions must use host-local calendar date obtained by converting an aware instant to the process timezone.
All production datetime UTC construction must use datetime.timezone.utc; the spelling datetime.UTC is prohibited for py310 target compatibility.
Timezone invariance of validation behavior must be proven by running tests under at least two distinct TZ process environments on platforms with time.tzset().
The shared Ruff configuration contract test must assert ASYNC selection, DTZ selection, absence of security selector S, and absence of Semgrep files.
